label: v3-ship-dry
pipeline: V3/compose case 2 (several sequences; references picked by hand, the state manager assumed perfect)
brief: A three-clip battleship sequence, widescreen, about 15 seconds per clip. Clip one: inside the ship, on the bridge, the captain and crew spot the enemy ship and the captain gives the command to fire. Clip two: outside, our battleship fires its main guns at the enemy ship on the horizon. Clip three: back on the same bridge with the same crew, the small tactical screen shows the enemy ship sinking, and the bridge celebrates.

llm.name: v3-sequencer-v1
llm.purpose: the story, the bible and the sequences

plan.story:
On a cold grey sea, the battleship Resolute closes on an enemy cruiser. Inside its narrow bridge, Captain Mara Voss watches the horizon while lookout Eli Reed scans through binoculars and tactical operator Nia Chen studies a small monitor. Reed spots a distant shape between the bridge-window frames: a dark-grey cruiser with two funnels and a broken white stripe along its hull. Voss confirms the contact, steadies herself against the brass chart rail, and orders, “Main battery, fire!”

Outside, the Resolute’s immense forward turrets train toward the cruiser, still only a small silhouette on the horizon. The guns discharge in a staggered salvo. Orange muzzle flashes briefly warm the grey steel, recoil drives the barrels backward, and smoke rolls across the deck. Around the distant cruiser, shell splashes rise and a compact flash marks a hit.

Back on the same bridge, Chen draws everyone toward the small tactical screen. Its monochrome remote-camera feed shows the recognizable cruiser listing and slipping beneath the water. Voss confirms the sinking. Reed raises a fist, Chen breaks into a relieved smile, and the captain finally allows herself one too.

plan.title: Resolute: Contact, Fire, Confirm

sequences.prose: The bridge is quiet except for machinery and the sea beyond the windows. Eli Reed lifts his binoculars and catches a distant cruiser crossing the horizon. He alerts Captain Mara Voss, who follows his pointing hand and confirms the silhouette. Nia Chen turns from her small tactical monitor, waiting for the decision. Voss plants one hand on the brass chart rail and gives the firing command. The moment ends on the crew’s immediate, disciplined response, before any gun is seen firing.

sequences.first_frame: Inside Resolute’s bridge, Captain Mara Voss stands at the brass chart rail between Eli Reed at the front windows and Nia Chen beside the small tactical screen. Reed’s binoculars hang from their brown neck strap; a tiny enemy cruiser sits beyond the slanted windows.
sequences.title: Contact on the Horizon
sequences.brief: Inside Resolute’s bridge: a narrow steel room, slanted front windows, brass chart rail overlooking a cold grey sea. Captain Mara Voss—short black hair, navy double-breasted coat, brass collar pin—stands centrally. Eli Reed—cropped brown hair, grey naval sweater, black headset—uses matte-black binoculars, broad eyecups, brown neck strap. Nia Chen—black bun, blue work shirt, rolled sleeves—sits beside a small square monitor, thick black bezel, green status lamp. Begin wide, then follow Reed pointing through the windows at a tiny horizon silhouette: a dark-grey cruiser, two funnels, broken white hull stripe, its details resolved in a brief optical close view. Reed says, “Enemy ship ahead.” Voss looks, grips the rail, and commands, “Main battery, fire!” Chen turns attentively. Keep cool overcast light and restrained blue-grey grading. This is clip 1 of 3; no guns discharge here, since the exterior firing belongs to clip 2.
progression: Inside the ship, establish the captain and crew on the bridge.
The crew spots the enemy ship on the horizon.
The captain gives the command to fire.
sequences.sound_why: The lookout’s report and captain’s firing command make the discovery and decision explicit, supported by subdued bridge machinery.

sequences.prose: Outside the Resolute, the scale changes from the confined bridge to an immense armoured deck above the sea. Its forward turrets turn slightly and settle on the enemy bearing. Far beyond the barrels, the cruiser remains a small shape against the horizon. The main guns fire in a staggered salvo, their recoil visible through sudden flame and expanding smoke. After a short interval, distant splashes bracket the cruiser and a brief flash marks a hit. The ship remains afloat when the clip ends.
sequences.first_frame: A wide exterior view establishes Resolute’s grey hull, white bow stripe and three triple-gun turrets. Beyond its bow, the enemy cruiser is a small silhouette on the horizon.
sequences.time: Same overcast day; immediately after the firing order
sequences.title: Main Battery

carries.what: Resolute, previously experienced from inside its bridge, is now established from outside.
The enemy cruiser remains the same distant target, identifiable by its two funnels and broken white hull stripe.

sequences.brief: Outside Resolute on a cold grey sea, low unbroken horizon, flat overcast sky: establish a grey battleship, three triple-gun turrets, white bow stripe in a wide bow-quarter view. No people are visible. Move closer above the forward deck as the forward turrets finish training toward the enemy. Beyond the barrels, keep the target small on the horizon: a dark-grey cruiser, two funnels, broken white hull stripe. The forward main guns fire a staggered salvo, with sharp orange flashes, clear barrel recoil, and heavy smoke moving away across the deck. Hold long enough for distant shell splashes and one compact flash beside the cruiser; it remains afloat. Use cool blue-grey grading, briefly warmed by muzzle flashes, with heavy reports and rolling echoes. This is clip 2 of 3; no bridge celebration or sinking is shown, since confirmation belongs to clip 3.
progression: Outside, establish our battleship and the enemy ship on the horizon.
Our battleship fires its main guns at the enemy ship.
sequences.sound_why: Gun reports, recoil mechanisms, wind and sea convey the salvo’s physical force without narration or music.

sequences.prose: The film returns to the same bridge, with Voss at the rail, Reed near the windows and Chen at her console. Chen calls their attention to the small tactical screen. The camera moves close enough to reveal a monochrome remote view of the enemy cruiser, its two funnels tilting as the hull sinks. Its last visible section disappears beneath the surface. Voss confirms what they have witnessed. Reed lowers his binoculars and raises a fist, Chen smiles in relief, and the captain’s stern expression softens into a restrained smile.

The enemy cruiser is now seen sinking within the tactical screen’s monochrome remote-camera feed, retaining its two funnels and broken white hull stripe.

sequences.brief: Inside Resolute’s bridge again: a narrow steel room, slanted front windows, brass chart rail above the grey sea. Captain Mara Voss—short black hair, navy double-breasted coat, brass collar pin—stands beside Eli Reed—cropped brown hair, grey naval sweater, black headset. Nia Chen—black bun, blue work shirt, rolled sleeves—beckons them toward a small square monitor, thick black bezel, green status lamp. Push close to its monochrome remote-camera feed, not a window view: a dark-grey cruiser, two funnels, broken white hull stripe lists and sinks completely. Keep the screen physically small, with its bezel visible throughout the insert; show no readable labels. Voss says, “Sinking confirmed.” Reed lowers matte-black binoculars, broad eyecups, brown neck strap, then raises a fist; Chen grins and Voss smiles. Maintain cool overcast light and blue-grey grading. This is clip 3 of 3; no further firing or exterior aftermath is shown—the film ends here.
progression: Return to the same bridge with the same captain and crew.
The small tactical screen shows the enemy ship sinking.
sequences.sound_why: A short spoken confirmation, relieved laughter and a brief wordless cheer make the screen’s result and the crew’s celebration clear.
